## Appearance

Charlie Sloane is known for his prominent, goggle eyes. His goggly appearance is notably pronounced when viewed in the moonlight, appearing even worse than during the day.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P23](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0023), [v3 ch.Autumn P6](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0006)_

## Personality

Charlie Sloane aspires to enter the political sphere and serve as a member of Parliament.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## History

In his past, Charlie indulged in literary flights. He traveled alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) by train and boat to [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) to attend college, later joining [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), and [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) on walks around the city. During his second term at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Charlie proposed to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), but she rejected him, causing tension between them.

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P0](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0000), [v3 ch.Farewell P2](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0002), [v3 ch.Farewell P4](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0004), [v3 ch.Farewell P10](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0010), [v3 ch.Farewell P24](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0024), [v3 ch.Park P14](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0014), +7 more_

## Relationships

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlie-sloane--gilbert-blythe.md)

Charlie and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are longtime friends from [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) who travel together to [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) to begin their studies at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). Despite their shared social circle and bond as friends, they are also rivals competing for the romantic affections of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P0](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0000), [v3 ch.Farewell P2](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0002), [v3 ch.Farewell P4](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0004), +3 more_

- Rival of — rivals for the affection of Anne (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P0](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0000)</sub>
- Friend of — longtime friends (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Park P11](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0011)</sub>
